lines.1: People say men have gotten weaker these days.
lines.3: Or rather, I hadn't... until now.
lines.4: A pair of eyes looked down at me as I sat crumpled on the ground.
lines.5: A gaze as keen as a honed blade.
lines.6: The girl who had just flattened me was a third-year--older than me, judging by the three stripes on her tie.
lines.7: With the spring sunlight at her back,
lines.10: she had the nerve to scold me in a voice clear as a bell.
lines.11: Her standing over me, me flat on the ground.
lines.12: It summed up our relationship perfectly.
lines.13: A dignified expression. A confident stance.
lines.14: Her neatly cropped hair stirred in the wind.
lines.15: ...That "incident" really drove one thing home for me.
lines.16: It's not so much that men have gotten weaker lately.
lines.17: Maybe girls have just gotten stronger?
